channel.title: The Temple News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Temple News (temple-news.com)

item.title: We should have taken more photos
item.description: A student reflects on growing up with an emotionally distant father and learning to cherish the time and memories that matter most.

item.title: Owls ready to bounce back in American Conference tournament
item.description: Temple stumbled to the tenth seed in the American Conference tournament after it finished the season going 1-7.

item.title: Owls strive to enter conference tournament with clean slate
item.description: Temple holds the seventh seed in the American Conference and aims to win the tournament for the first time in program history.

item.title: Muslim, Catholic students fast, souls are fed: Ramadan, Lent create community on campus
item.description: Across the university, students are bringing religious tradition to student-led spaces.

item.title: Turner’s 31 points advance Owls to second round
item.description: Guard Kaylah Turner went 3-3 from three-point range in overtime of Temple’s 86-77 win against Tulane in the first round of the American Conference tournament.

item.title: Climbing the mountain: What to know for Temple’s game against UTSA
item.description: Temple is taking on a UTSA team it lost to twice in the regular season after beating Tulane in the first round of the American tournament.

item.title: March 11: Plans to Implement AI at TU
item.description: RePrint is your biweekly rundown of the stories you need to know about from The Temple News. It is available on Wednesdays featuring Ariana Droz and other editors from The Temple News

item.title: Owls’ season ends at hands of Roadrunners
item.description: Temple shot 32.2% from the field and 25% from three-point range in its 59-51 loss to UTSA in the second round of the American Conference tournament.

item.title: Temple goes home without a win in American Conference tournament
item.description: Temple fell to Florida Atlantic 63-59 Wednesday night in the first round of the American Conference tournament.

item.title: “We’re all under attack:” Hundreds protest ICE at Bell Tower
item.description: Students and local activism groups rallied to support Jerome Richardson and advocate for the right to protest.
